verdict.rationale: The evidence pack has no documentation of Avalara filing state or local sales tax permit registrations on the user's behalf, and none of per-registration pricing or registration status tracking. Nexus declarations (CreateNexus) only record where tax obligations exist, and Managed Returns covers return filing; both are adjacent features, not registration services. A community comment says tools like Avalara still require separately handling per-jurisdiction tax registration.

support.subject: As an ops user, registering for a sales tax permit is handled in-product — the vendor files state and local registrations on my behalf with transparent per-registration pricing and status tracking
